task_description: Write a method in Dafny to join an array of multiple integers into a single integer.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method JoinArray(a: array<int>) returns (result: int)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The result is the concatenation of all integers in the input array in order
    - The length of the result corresponds to the total number of digits formed by concatenating each element
    - The result correctly represents the sequence of integers joined together without any separators
